With this final subject, Primary Endpoint analysis is anticipated to begin in December 2026 and topline results are anticipated in Q1 2027.

The topline results included: 50% Objective Response Rate (ORR), including 21% complete responses; 79% Clinical Benefit Rate; Median Overall Survival of 32.5 months; durable responses exceeding 70+ months in select patients; and no Grade 4 or 5 toxicities observed.

The topline results from the study confirm the positive findings that were previously presented at the 2022 Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer (SITC) 37th Annual Meeting in a poster presentation titled Safety and efficacy of de-escalated neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy of triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) using chemokine-modulating regimen (rintatolimod, IFN-α2b, celecoxib).

All patients completed the study, and topline data was reported in February 2024. 39 In January 2025, we announced that the final Clinical Study results from AMP-518 had been posted to ClinicalTrials.gov.
